summary: The demo app's site model under apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/lib/site/ used PascalCase filenames (MagicShop.ts, CartPage.ts, HomePage.ts, LoginPage.ts, AccountPage.ts, ProductDetailsPage.ts, ReagentMapPage.ts), violating the project's name.type.ts kebab-case file-naming rule that flows/draw-line.flow.ts already followed. This is a pure rename: the site file becomes magic-shop.site.ts and the six page files become *.page.ts, every class name stays exactly as it is today, and every import of those files is rewritten to the new path with no other change to its line. A prior developer attempt already performed every rename and import update correctly on disk, but the pipeline rejected that stage because it reported the renames as `old -> new` pairs inside `filesModified`, a format loom's state validator cannot resolve (it checks each listed path exists and has no field for a removed file). This analysis update exists to make the developer stage report the same, already-correct work in the format loom accepts: each renamed file listed once by its new path in `filesCreated`, and only files whose import lines changed (but which were not themselves renamed) listed as plain paths in `filesModified`. No .feature file, assertion, or runtime behavior changes; the existing Cucumber and Playwright suites must pass identically before and after.
